as_told.title: Gemini 11 UFO electromagnetic outage and Simpkinson archive photo

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that during Gemini 11, a 1966 NASA mission that orbited Earth with astronauts Pete Conrad and Richard Gordon, the radio transcripts describe an object passing by and the spacecraft's batteries draining one after another. In a later episode he says that researchers Kevin Knuth and Chris Ramsay told him it looks like a real unknown object caused an electrical outage, and he points to a photo from a NASA archive, which would mean something interfered with an American spacecraft.
